_meta.purpose: Ground-truth reference set for validating the stem-loop RT-qPCR primer designer.
_meta.design_is_deterministic_note: For Chen-2005 stem-loop RT-qPCR, two of the three primers are fully determined by the mature miRNA sequence: (1) the RT stem-loop primer = fixed universal body + reverse-complement of the 3'-terminal 6 nt; (2) the universal reverse primer is a fixed constant. The forward primer's specific region equals the 5' prefix of the miRNA. The validator recomputes these expected values independently from the SAME sequence the tool used (returned in metadata.mirna_sequence), so results do not depend on any hand-entered sequence.
sources: [Chen05] Chen C et al. Nucleic Acids Res. 2005;33(20):e179 — original stem-loop RT-qPCR; RT primer hybridizes 6-8 nt at 3' end of mature miRNA.

[Wang17] Wang Y et al. Mol Med Rep. 2017;17(3):3690-3696. DOI 10.3892/mmr.2017.8297 (PubMed PMID 29257343) — let-7 members share 16 identical 5' nt; single-nucleotide discrimination; amplification efficiency 0.93-1.14.
[Var07] Varkonyi-Gasic E et al. Plant Methods 2007;3:12 — protocol; 6-nt overhang optimal.
[MIQE09] Bustin SA et al. Clin Chem 2009;55(4):611-622. DOI 10.1373/clinchem.2008.112797 (PMID 19246619) — qPCR efficiency 90-110% acceptable.

_published_primer_exact_match.purpose: OPTIONAL exact-match layer vs a real published primer table. Absent by default — sequences are NEVER fabricated; add them only from a cited paper table.
_published_primer_exact_match.how_to_add: On any entry in `mirnas`, add one or more of: `published_rt` (full stem-loop RT primer), `published_rt_overhang` (3' 6-nt overhang only), `published_forward` (forward qPCR primer), `published_source` (citation). U/T and case are normalized before comparison.
checks_emitted: published_forward_contains_specific — published forward contains the tool's miRNA-specific region (tolerant of differing 5' tails)
_published_primer_exact_match.caveat: Exact forward-primer match only holds vs papers using the SAME universal stem-loop tail (Chen 2005 system). For different tails, rely on `published_forward_contains_specific`.

mirnas.role: canonical positive control; widely published stem-loop assay target

mirnas.note: [Wang17]: let-7a/c/f differ by as little as 1 nt; specificity module SHOULD flag siblings.

mirnas.role: common reference/normalizer miRNA; EXACT-MATCH anchor vs a published stem-loop primer set using the identical Chen-2005 universal body + reverse
mirnas.published_source: 'Designing a stem-loop RT-qPCR method for measuring miRNA-16 expression in human plasma samples' — Table 1 'Sequence and characteristics of the stem-loop RT-qPCR primers set'. Uses the same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body and universal reverse as this tool; the tool's RT primer and reverse are byte-identical to this published set.

mirnas.role: cross-system forward-primer concordance vs a DIFFERENT universal stem-loop system (Yang 2014 USLP) — validates the miRNA-specific forward-primer principle across independent chemistries
mirnas.published_source: Yang L-h, et al. Universal Stem-Loop Primer Method. PLoS ONE 2014;9(12):e115293. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0115293 — miR-150 forward qPCR primer (5' GC tail added to raise Tm). NOTE: Yang 2014 uses a different stem-loop body and reverse (random 3' end), so only the forward miRNA-specific core is comparable; no RT exact-match applies.

mirnas.role: cross-system RT-overhang + forward concordance vs a DIFFERENT universal stem-loop system (Czimmerer 2013). The 6-nt RT overhang (the miRNA-specific biological invariant) matches across systems even though the stem-loop bodies differ.
mirnas.published_source: Czimmerer Z, et al. A Versatile Method to Design Stem-Loop Primer-Based Quantitative PCR Assays. PLoS ONE 2013;8(1):e55168. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0055168, Table 2 (mmu-mir-1; sequence identical to hsa-miR-1-3p). NOTE: different universal body (GTTGGCTCTGG...CCAGAGCCAAC) and reverse (GTGCAGGGTCCGAGGT), so no full-RT exact-match applies — only the 6-nt overhang and the forward miRNA-specific core are comparable.

mirnas.role: cross-system RT-overhang + forward concordance vs Czimmerer 2013 (different universal body). Confirms the deterministic overhang rule holds for a 23-nt miRNA in an independent published assay.
mirnas.published_source: Czimmerer Z, et al. PLoS ONE 2013;8(1):e55168. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0055168, Table 2 (hsa-mir-181a). Different universal body/reverse — overhang + forward-core comparison only.

mirnas.role: SECOND full-RT EXACT-MATCH anchor. Uses the identical Chen-2005 universal body as this tool; RT primer is byte-identical. Verified: 3' UUGUGA -> revcomp TCACAA matches the published stem-loop 3' overhang.
mirnas.published_source: Ngo Thi Mai Vy (student ID 20187223). 'Development of the Quantification Procedure for miR-125b-5p in Human Plasma Samples Using Stemloop RT-qPCR.' Bachelor's thesis (lab internal, unpublished). Same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body; universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC (18 nt, a different loop window than this tool's fixed 20-nt reverse, so reverse is not exact-matched). RT overhang TCACAA = revcomp of 3'-terminal UUGUGA (independently verified).

mirnas.role: forward-core concordance + demonstrates the Chen 6-8 nt binding range. The published RT used a 7-nt overhang (GCCAATA = revcomp of 3' UAUUGGC... last 7 nt), whereas this tool uses a fixed 6-nt overhang (GCCAAT). No 6-nt RT exact-match is asserted; only the forward-specific core is scored.
mirnas.published_source: Zhao F-L, Dou Y-C, Wang X-F, Han D-C, Lv Z-G, Ge S-L, Zhang Y-K. 'Serum microRNA-195 is down-regulated in breast cancer: a potential marker for the diagnosis of breast cancer.' Mol Biol Rep. 2014;41(9):5913-5922. DOI 10.1007/s11033-014-3466-1, Table 2 ('The sequences of miR-16 and miR-195 stem-loop RT and PCR primers'). Same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body (GTCGTATCCAGTGCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTCGCACTGGATACGAC) and universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC. NOTE: the published RT hybridizes 7 nt (GCCAATA = revcomp of 3'-terminal UAUUGGC); this tool's fixed 6-nt overhang (GCCAAT) is the 6-nt prefix of it — a deliberate design choice within Chen's 6-8 nt binding range, not a mismatch. Forward-specific core comparison only.

mirnas.role: forward-core concordance. Published forward (GGCGCC tail + ATAAAGCTAGATAAC) anchors the miRNA 5' prefix. Qualitative support for the short-duplex Tm caveat: the published table lists the 50-nt stem-loop primer Tm as 16 C, illustrating why a point Tm on the 6-nt binding duplex is not meaningful.
mirnas.published_source: Truong Gia Hung. 'Xay dung quy trinh dinh luong miR-9-3p trong huyet tuong bang phuong phap stemloop RT-qPCR' (Building a quantification procedure for miR-9-3p in plasma by stem-loop RT-qPCR). Bachelor's thesis (lab internal, unpublished), 'Bang 3.2'. Universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC. Forward-specific core comparison only (stem-loop 3' overhang in the source table was not machine-legible).

mirnas.role: THIRD full-RT EXACT-MATCH anchor. Identical Chen-2005 universal body; RT primer byte-identical. Verified: 3' CUGGGU -> revcomp ACCCAG matches the published stem-loop 3' overhang.
mirnas.published_source: Le Tran Bao Bao. 'Xay dung quy trinh dinh luong miR-222-3p trong huyet tuong bang phuong phap stemloop RT-qPCR' (Building a quantification procedure for miR-222-3p in plasma by stem-loop RT-qPCR). Bachelor's thesis (lab internal, unpublished). Same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body; universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC (18-nt loop window, not exact-matched vs this tool's 20-nt reverse). RT overhang ACCCAG = revcomp of 3'-terminal CUGGGU (independently verified). Published amplicon 56 bp.

mirnas.role: FOURTH full-RT EXACT-MATCH anchor (sibling of miR-222-3p; family 221-3p/222-3p). Identical Chen-2005 universal body; RT primer byte-identical. Verified: 3' GGUUUC -> revcomp GAAACC matches the published stem-loop 3' overhang.
mirnas.published_source: Tran Thuy Linh. 'Xay dung quy trinh dinh luong miR-221-3p trong huyet tuong bang phuong phap stemloop RT-qPCR' (Building a quantification procedure for miR-221-3p in plasma by stem-loop RT-qPCR). Bachelor's thesis (lab internal, unpublished). Same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body; universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC (18-nt loop window, not exact-matched vs this tool's 20-nt reverse). RT overhang GAAACC = revcomp of 3'-terminal GGUUUC (independently verified).
